In such cases, offsetting would be equal to realisation of export proceeds and exporter would have to submit following additional documents: (a) Appendix-2L in lieu of Bank Realisation Certificate. (b) Specific permission of RBI. PROVISIONS RELATED TO QUALITY CERTIFICATION:
